channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PT não desistiu do apoio do Centrão no primeiro turno, mesmo com neutralidade dos principais partidos
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva said the party has not abandoned efforts to secure electoral support from Centrão parties in the first round of the 2026 presidential election, despite neutrality declarations from Progressistas, União Brasil, and Republicanos. He stated that dialogue will begin immediately following the official start of campaigning on Monday, emphasizing that 'no game is won without being played.' The PSD, while fielding its own candidate (Ronaldo Caiado), supports Lula in certain states such as Bahia and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a passar por atendimento odontológico
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to leave house arrest for a dental appointment with dentist Fernanda Antunes Figueira Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The visit will be escorted by the Military Police Battalion and held at the Military Police Medical Center, with date and time kept confidential. This is Bolsonaro’s first leave since May 4, when he underwent a shoulder procedure.

item.title: Daniela Lima: Bolsonarismo focou em detratar Caiado após críticas a Flávio
item.description: The rise in rejection of Ronaldo Caiado was driven by the negative reaction from Bolsonarists to his criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro, according to columnist Daniela Lima on UOL News. Although Caiado is the PSD candidate, his critical stance toward the former president's son triggered a backlash from Bolsonaro supporters, damaging his image.

item.title: Flávio compartilha vídeo com informaçăo falsa sobre compras em mercado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shared an Instagram video containing false information about supermarket shopping, in which a woman claimed to have spent a lot of money on few products while omitting other purchased items. The content was used to criticize alleged high prices but represents misinformation about the cost of living.

item.title: Kassab: PSD năo é Centrăo e tem candidato próprio; Caiado é competitivo e tem equipe boa
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate, stated that the party is not part of the 'Centrão' and has its own candidate for the 2026 elections. He also praised Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado, calling him competitive and well-supported by a strong team.

item.title: Em reaproximação, Alcolumbre exalta Lula: “Enfrentou tudo e todos”
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) publicly praised President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) during a visit to a Petrobras research vessel in Oiapoque (AP), stating that Lula 'faced everything and everyone' to advance the Margem Equatorial oil exploration project. The remarks mark the first joint public appearance between the two since the restoration of dialogue following tensions over the rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. Alcolumbre, who aims to run again for Senate presidency in 2027, used the occasion to strengthen institutional rapprochement with the government.

item.title: Nunes Marques convida países a conhecerem “confiabilidade das eleições”
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques invited representatives from 88 countries to observe Brazil's 2026 elections, emphasizing the reliability and transparency of the electoral system. The event featured presentations on electronic voting machines, electoral technology, disinformation, and artificial intelligence, with specific concerns raised about deepfakes and voice cloning targeting candidates. The United States also sent representatives, underscoring international interest in Brazil's democratic process.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja quem são os 13 candidatos à Presidência que pediram registro de candidatura ao TSE
item.description: Thirteen candidates have filed to run for President in the 2026 elections, including Lula (PT) seeking a fourth term, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), and others from parties such as Novo, PCB, PSTU, and UP. The TSE is now reviewing documentation to validate registrations, while campaigning has officially begun with permitted street and online advertising.

item.title: Meta descumpre regra eleitoral e recomenda perfis de candidatos
item.description: Meta is failing to comply with TSE resolution prohibiting social media platforms from recommending official candidate profiles during the electoral period, with Instagram and Facebook showing candidate content to users who do not follow them. The rule, updated in 2024, bans algorithms from ranking, recommending, or prioritizing political campaigns except for paid promotion. X (formerly Twitter) has already adjusted its algorithm to comply, while Meta continues to violate Brazilian electoral law.

item.title: TSE lança campanha para estimular participação nas eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched the 'Elections 2026 – Coisa de Pele' campaign to encourage voter participation in the October 2026 general elections. Led by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, the initiative positions the voter as the protagonist of democracy, using cultural elements like Jorge Aragão’s music to promote inclusivity, diversity, and voter education on voting procedures and ballot justification. The videos and audio spots are now available on TSE’s social media profiles.

item.title: Petrobras confirma petróleo na Foz do Amazonas; veja o que descoberta significa para o Brasil
item.description: Petrobras confirmed the presence of oil in the Morpho well, located in the Foz do Amazonas Basin off the coast of Amapá, marking a significant step in the exploration of Brazil’s Equatorial Margin. However, the company emphasized that the discovery does not yet confirm a commercially viable field, as further drilling, reservoir analysis, and recoverable volume estimates are still required. Petrobras plans additional wells in the area to assess the region’s long-term production potential.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro estende estadia em MG e fará ato com Nikolas nesta 3ª
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) extended his stay in Belo Horizonte until Tuesday morning (08/18) after canceling events in Juiz de Fora due to bad weather. He will participate in a sticker campaign and press conference with federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL), as well as the launch of Flávio Roscoe's campaign — a candidate Bolsonaro endorsed for a legislative seat in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Marqueteiro deixa campanha de Caiado após divergências
item.description: Mineiro strategist Paulo Vasconcelos left the presidential campaign of Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) due to disagreements over electoral strategy. Allies stated that Vasconcelos favored an approach based on Caiado’s gubernatorial record in Goiás, while the candidate pursued a different direction. His departure occurred early in the year, shortly after being appointed to lead the campaign’s marketing efforts.

item.title: ‘Os americanos não vão resolver um problema que é nosso’, diz Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, said the U.S. should not solve Brazil's security issues, particularly regarding PCC and Comando Vermelho, and advocated for a joint police force with neighboring countries to improve cooperation. He also criticized Finance Minister Dario Durigan, claiming the Lula government presents an overly optimistic economic outlook disconnected from reality, citing Casas Bahia's judicial recovery and excessive public spending beyond the fiscal framework.

item.title: Renan diz que candidatura de Marçal beneficia Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, said Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) candidacy benefits Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), acting as a 'folkloric figure' to distract and favor Bolsonaro clan interests. He described Marçal's entry as expected and part of a larger political strategy.

item.title: Justiça derruba vídeo em que Lucas Pavanato ataca Erika Hilton
item.description: São Paulo's Electoral Justice ordered the removal of a campaign video by councilman Lucas Pavanato (PL) that falsely accused federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSOL) of using public funds to hire makeup artists and attacked her gender identity. The decision followed a preliminary injunction by Hilton's legal team, which provided evidence from the Chamber of Deputies disproving the claims. Social media platforms were required to take down the video within 24 hours, and Pavanato was barred from reposting it under threat of a daily fine of R$ 1,000, capped at R$ 50,000.

item.title: "Fomos pegos de surpresa", diz chefe do União-SP sobre saída de Marçal
item.description: Milton Leite, president of União Brasil in São Paulo, said the party was caught off guard by Pablo Marçal's decision to return to PRTB after obtaining a retroactive injunction that restored his affiliation and allowed him to register a presidential candidacy, despite being ineligible until 2032. The party had been working to reverse his legal situation and hoped to nominate him as a federal or state deputy as a vote-getter. Leite said he respects Marçal's choice and will wait for further developments.

item.title: Acusado de censura, Moraes vai falar sobre democracia na USP
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes will speak on democracy and voting at the University of São Paulo (USP) Law School next Friday, the 21st. The event comes days after journalist Luís Pablo accused Moraes of censorship in a controversial case. The talk will focus on 'Vote and Democracy'.

item.title: Sandro Alex admite apoio paralelo a Flávio Bolsonaro no Paraná mesmo com prioridade a Caiado
item.description: Federal deputy Sandro Alex (PSD-PR), a candidate for governor of Paraná, stated on Monday that his political group will support more than one presidential candidate in 2026, with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) as the main choice. He added that Paraná leaders also sympathize with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), Renan Santos (Missão) and Romeu Zema (Novo).

item.title: Crusoé: Janja só é carismática sem microfone
item.description: Lula’s campaign team is banking on First Lady Janja da Silva to win over women and evangelical voters, assigning her issues like fighting femicide, defending animals, and censoring social media. However, the article claims that whenever Janja speaks into a microphone, her impact is the opposite of intended, triggering backlash rather than support.

item.title: Zema diz que governo Lula é “pró-bilionário”
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), presidential candidate in 2026, criticized the Lula government as 'pro-billionaire' for keeping the Selic rate at 14%, arguing it benefits those with invested money while harming debtors and producers. He proposed cutting the Selic to 6%, which would save R$ 800 billion annually in public debt service, and stated this reduction would depend on strict fiscal control, with measures tougher than those under Temer's administration.

item.title: O novo reforço da equipe jurídica de campanha de Lula
item.description: Rafael Carneiro, a lawyer linked to Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, has been invited to join the legal team of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign. A specialist in electoral and constitutional law with experience at the TSE and STF, Carneiro already represents the PSB and Alckmin. The hiring reflects anticipation of a highly litigious electoral process.

item.title: “Lula urso musculoso”: sósia do presidente faz sucesso no Onlyfans
item.description: A Los Angeles-based man went viral on social media for his striking resemblance to Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, adopting the nickname 'your affectionate muscular bear' on the @whosthatcub profile. He began posting content on OnlyFans using Lula’s likeness, the Brazilian flag, and engaging with Brazilian users, sparking humorous comments and even electoral-themed jokes about the look-alike running for office.

item.title: Kassio fala sobre música de Jorge Aragão e Eleições 2026
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques launched the 'Elections 2026 – Coisa de Pele' campaign, inspired by Jorge Aragão’s song, emphasizing popular culture and the people’s will as central to the electoral process. He praised electronic voting machines as a democratic heritage, highlighting Brazil’s transparency and expertise in elections, and inaugurated the Elections Dissemination Center (CDE) 2026 to support media coverage.

item.title: Ciro Gomes e Camilo Santana abrem campanha no Ceará com trocas de acusações: 'Novo coronel'
item.description: Ciro Gomes accused Camilo Santana of being the 'new colonel of Ceará' and of abusively interfering in the judiciary to sabotage his coalition with the União Progressista federation. Camilo rebutted, calling the accusation a sign of 'desperation' and attributing the legal actions to state leaders of União Brasil and PP, claiming Ciro is the real colonel who believes he rules the state.

item.title: Zema defende 'privatizar tudo', reforma administrativa e previdenciária
item.description: Romeu Zema, the presidential candidate from the Novo party, advocated four pillars in his government plan: privatization, administrative reform, pension reform, and a review of social programs. His remarks were made at the 27th Annual Santander Conference in São Paulo, reinforcing his liberal agenda and state reduction stance.

item.title: Trabalho da imprensa é 'essencial' para eleições e democracia, diz Kassio Nunes Marques
item.description: The president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Kassio Nunes Marques, stated that the work of Brazilian and foreign journalists is essential for the electoral process and that a free and participatory press is synonymous with democracy.

item.title: Quinze entidades pressionam Lula por reunião de emergência sobre o Rio Tapajós
item.description: Fifteen entities, including CNT, CNI, ABTP, IBP, and ABIOVE, sent a joint letter to President Lula requesting an emergency meeting on the suspended maintenance dredging of the Tapajós River, warning that inaction could cause supply shortages for 7.5 million people, raise prices, cause unemployment, and trigger economic collapse, worsened by the risk of prolonged drought due to El Niño.

item.title: Zema chama beneficiários de programas sociais de “imprestáveis”
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized social programs for creating a 'generation of unemployables' who refuse formal jobs and prefer informal work ('bicos'). He advocated suspending payments for beneficiaries who reject three job offers and requiring completion of elementary or high school as a condition. The remarks were made at the 27th Annual Santander Conference in São Paulo.

item.title: As mudanças que Renan Santos fará com a aposentadoria se for eleito
item.description: Renan Santos proposes decoupling pension benefits from the minimum wage, adjusting them only for inflation while keeping the minimum wage valorization rule unchanged. He argues the current linkage pressures public finances and fuels inflation, creating a 'give with one hand, take with the other' effect. His proposal is part of a broader agenda of de-indexation and public spending cuts, including reviewing privileges for high-ranking officials and tax renouncements to large corporations.

item.title: No Z-4, Vasco enfrentará times do top-5 nas próximas três rodadas
item.description: Vasco da Gama is in 19th place in the 2026 Brasileirão with 22 points after a 3-0 loss to Santos in round 23. The team faces a tough stretch against Palmeiras (1st), Cruzeiro (5th), and Fluminense (4th) in the next three rounds. Despite the pressure, Vasco has a game in hand and still has fixtures in the Copa Sudamericana and Copa do Brasil.

item.title: Segurança pública é tema mais visitado por candidatos à presidência em primeiro dia de campanha
item.description: On the first official day of the presidential campaign, candidates Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado, and Renan Santos emphasized public security as a central theme. Lula promised to create a Ministry of Public Security and compared his record on fighting organized crime to Bolsonaro’s. Flávio Bolsonaro focused on hardening measures against criminal factions and labeling them as terrorists, speaking from Copacabana.

item.title: Requião Filho reitera apoio a Lula e chama Lava Jato de ‘fraude política’
item.description: Requião Filho, PDT candidate for governor of Paraná, reiterated his support for Lula's re-election and labeled Operation Lava Jato a 'great political fraud,' claiming the convictions were annulled due to Sergio Moro's partial actions and collusion with the Public Prosecutor's Office. He said he prefers to focus on Paraná's proposals and views Lula as the only option to defend democracy, despite having left the PT last year.

item.title: A embaixadores, Nunes Marques diz que criou sala de crise com big techs
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques announced the establishment of a crisis room with digital platforms for the weekends of the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections. The statement was made during a meeting with 57 ambassadors at the electoral court headquarters.

item.title: Plataformas se comprometeram a participar de sala de situação nas eleições, diz Nunes Marques
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kássio Nunes Marques, stated that digital platforms have committed to participating in a situation room during both rounds of the 2026 elections, in addition to submitting compliance plans. The initiative aims to monitor and counter misinformation and abuses on social media during the electoral process.

item.title: Candidatos com número que contém 67 apostam no meme ‘six seven’ para ficar na cabeça do eleitor
item.description: Six federal deputy candidates across different Brazilian states are using the 'six seven' meme as a campaign strategy, linking their ballot numbers ending in 67 to jingles, gestures, and viral content popular among youth. Authorized by the Electoral Justice, the tactic aims to embed voters' memory of their ballot numbers through digital cultural references, including arm-waving motions and the concept of 'farming aura'.

item.title: A embaixadores, Nunes Marques destaca parceria com plataformas e segurança das urnas
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques emphasized partnerships with digital platforms and the security of electronic voting machines during an event with ambassadors from 89 countries. He warned about the risks of disinformation and malicious AI use in the 2026 elections, citing agreements with companies like ElevenLabs to block voice cloning of candidates and the launch of an Action Plan for AI use in informational integrity.

item.title: Renan Santos vê Flávio e Lula como centro e diz que direita populista representada por Trump morreu
item.description: Renan Santos, the Partido Missão presidential candidate, claimed Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are centrist candidates, arguing that polarization is not driven by radical left or right, and that Trump-led populist right has died even in the U.S. He accused Flávio of supporting individuals linked to the Red Command, called for banning all betting sites, criticized the Desenrola program for encouraging default, and urged a pension reform PEC to be passed this year.

item.title: Especialistas defendem tecnologia e reformas para desafogar Judiciário em seminário da Folha
item.description: Experts advocate for technology and institutional reforms to alleviate Brazil's judicial backlog, emphasizing digital management tools as a solution to court congestion. The discussion took place during a Folha de S.Paulo seminar on March 17, 2026.

item.title: PF encontra mensagem em que Lulinha e lobista investigada por fraudes no INSS tratam de negócios: ‘Nosso futuro é Suiça’
item.description: The Federal Police found messages between Lulinha, son of President Lula, and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, under investigation for alleged fraud in the INSS, in which she stated 'our future is Switzerland' and that they operate on 'another level'. Lulinha replied that he 'works like crazy and never gets anywhere'. The conversations are part of ongoing investigations at the Supreme Federal Court over suspected influence peddling, also involving former Lula aides such as Marcola and Swedenberger Barbosa.

item.title: O ‘carinho da torcida’ com Flávio Bolsonaro em São Januário
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, attended the Vasco vs. Santos match at São Januário stadium after launching his campaign in Copacabana. He arrived under a heavy police escort, with Federal Police vehicles entering via the parking lot, underscoring the heightened security surrounding his public appearance.

item.title: TSE recebe embaixadores de 57 países para falar de urnas eletrônicas
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques hosted ambassadors from 57 countries to present Brazil’s electronic voting system and discuss the reliability of the 2026 elections. The event featured sessions on disinformation, AI, and electoral technology, plus a hands-on voting simulation. The TSE also announced an international observation program for the first round on October 2–4, allowing foreign missions to monitor all stages of the electoral process.

item.title: TSE recebe representantes de 88 países para falar de urnas eletrônicas
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques hosted representatives from 88 countries in Brasília to present Brazil's electronic voting system and discuss the 2026 elections, emphasizing transparency and countering disinformation. The event featured sessions on electoral technology, artificial intelligence, and a voting simulation, alongside the announcement of an international observation program for the October first round.

item.title: Ação do Novo leva TSE a investigar Lula por desfile de Carnaval
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has decided to investigate President Lula over alleged abuse of economic power and improper use of communication media, following a complaint by the Novo party. The case concerns public funding for a samba school parade that honored the president during the 2026 Carnival. The action claims that using public funds to promote a political figure violates electoral law.

item.title: Maioria de mulheres e jovens acompanharão campanha eleitoral exclusivamente pela TV, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A majority of Brazilian female voters (51%) plan to follow the electoral broadcast exclusively on television, compared to 37% of men, according to the BTG/Nexus poll. This underscores TV's significance as a communication channel for women and youth in the 2026 elections, a demographic seen as pivotal for the presidential outcome. The electoral campaign on TV begins on August 28.

item.title: Durigan defende rigor na responsabilidade fiscal e fala em ‘liderança global’ do Brasil
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stressed the importance of fiscal responsibility amid global uncertainty, stating that a potential Lula re-election in 2026 would lead the government to focus on the electric sector, biofuels, critical minerals, and AI to position Brazil as a global leader. He praised the fiscal framework and tax reform as key practices to maintain and improve, and noted that legal mechanisms have been introduced to curb rising mandatory spending, insisting that fiscal irresponsibility will not be tolerated despite political polarization.

item.title: Vídeo: Urna eletrônica: é preciso tomar cuidado com boatos e fake news
item.description: It is important to be alert to rumors and false news about electronic voting machines in Brazil, such as the claim that they are connected to the internet or that they cannot be audited. Senate Verifica provides a WhatsApp channel (61) 98190-0601 to clarify doubts and combat misinformation about the electoral process.

item.title: Lula e Flávio decidem não ir ao debate da “Band”
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are unlikely to attend the Band debate on August 23, after the network rescheduled the date from August 16 to increase the president's chances of participation. Lula's team believes he would be the main target in debates dominated by right-wing candidates, while Flávio has stated he will only debate if Lula is present. Both are prioritizing campaign and government activities, with Lula aiming to participate in higher-viewership debates, such as those on TV Globo.

item.title: Brasiline anuncia nova marca: ARX CYBER
item.description: Brasiline Tecnology rebranded as ARX CYBER on August 11, 2026, at the Fortinet Cybersecurity Summit Brasil in São Paulo, signaling a strategic shift toward cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and digital resilience. The new name, derived from the Latin 'arx' meaning fortress, reflects the company’s mission to simplify security and enable business continuity without adding complexity. This evolution mirrors 23 years of transformation from perimeter-based security to protecting hybrid, cloud-native, and interconnected digital ecosystems.

item.title: Plano de governo de Tarcísio mais que dobra citações a segurança e triplica menções a mulheres
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas filed his 2026 re-election government plan, highlighting a tripling in mentions of public safety (from 23 to 54) and a more than tripling of references to women (from 19 to 63). The 68-page document introduces new topics like AI and climate change, and proposes expanding the SP Mobile app, Muralha Paulista surveillance network, and organized crime combat, while tripling 24/7 specialized police units for women’s protection.
